method: One GET per public image URL, four concurrent workers, 20-second timeout; JPEG signature and SOF dimensions validated. Known visually verified placeholder/blank-image hashes rejected. All recurring hashes and JPEGs under3KB manually inspected. Does not establish image age or detect every source fault.
